sources.label: SpyLand.ing home
sources.claim: Spyland watches competitor landing pages on a schedule — weekly on the Free plan, daily on paid plans — and flags copy, pricing, and CTA changes with before/after captures and a short AI read.

sources.label: SpyLand.ing pricing
sources.claim: Spyland publishes a Free plan ($0/mo, no credit card) with weekly checks, plus paid Solo and Business plans with daily checks; dollar prices are not printed on the page — paid plans are chosen from the workspace, billed monthly.
